title: Busan & Jeju filming locations: 8 K-drama and K-pop spots
desc: K-drama, variety show and K-pop music video filming locations outside Seoul, grouped into Busan and Jeju.

items.title: Hansung Housing (한성주택)
items.memo: Fight for My Way: the leads' home, Namil Villa, from episode 1.

items.title: Dadaepo Beach (다대포해수욕장)
items.memo: The King: Eternal Monarch: the horse-riding scene in episode 1.

items.title: Gamcheon Culture Village (감천문화마을)
items.memo: Running Man ep. 126 was filmed on the Gamnae Community Centre roof.

items.title: Jagalchi Market (자갈치시장)
items.memo: Chase scenes in Ode to My Father and Black Panther.

items.title: Seongsan Ilchulbong (성산일출봉)
items.memo: Featured in Soyou's 'The Blue Night of Jeju Island' music video.

items.title: Maze Land (메이즈랜드)
items.memo: Maze chase scenes in Legend of the Blue Sea ep. 2.

items.title: Wind 1947 (윈드1947)
items.memo: Go-kart track from Oh My Girl's 'Dun Dun Dance' MV.

items.title: Jeju Shinhwa World (제주신화월드)
items.memo: Neon arcade from Oh My Girl's 'Dun Dun Dance' MV.
